answer: Every identity must file a court-stamped jury duty certificate. The summons arrives by post, the person shows photo ID at the courthouse door, spends a full day in court, and the clerk stamps the certificate before the court publishes the attendance roll. A no-show voids the identity the same day. One fake identity costs a full court day plus $60 in travel and lost time, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 court days and $60,000. A duplicate name stands out like yarrow growing through basalt, and the public roll is a beacon anyone can check before trusting a stranger.
